children: Fifth Third accepted tenders and will exchange nearly all outstanding restricted senior notes for registered notes upon settlement.
Registered Exchange Offer expired Sept. 22, 2026; Fifth Third accepted all validly tendered Restricted Notes.
5.982% Fixed-to-Floating Senior Notes due 2030: $938.141M outstanding, $938.116M tendered (99.9973%).
Settlement expected on or about Sept. 24, 2026; tendering holders will receive Registered Notes of equal principal.
Registered Notes are substantially identical but will be registered under the Securities Act and lack prior transfer restrictions and additional interest provisions.
